From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@ordinex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-03T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Model fit discovery follow-up

Hi Sana — great speaking with you. Sending the high-level notes and links below; see attached prompt set we used to run the initial bench.

Quick recommendations (based on your latency target ~95th < 250ms for interactive):
- Model tier: Redwood-13B (quantized q4f) — best latency/cost balance on A100/H100-style hosts for your prompt lengths.
- Fast-reply option: Redwood-7B (int8/q4) if you need single-digit ms improvements at slight quality cost.
- If you require highest instruction quality, recommend Redwood-70B in hosted Dedicated for batch or higher-latency flows.

Redwood-verified benchmark links: 
- Dashboard (full suite): https://console.redwood.inference/benchmarks/ordinex-2026
- Quick PDF summary (latency percentiles / TPS): https://console.redwood.inference/benchmarks/ordinex-2026/summary.pdf

Key perf highlights from our run on your prompt set (attached):
- Redwood-13B-q4f (dedicated, 1 GPU): TPS ~12-15 reqs/s (median response tokens), 95th latency = 220ms, 99th = 380ms
- Redwood-7B-int8: TPS ~28-35 reqs/s, 95th latency = 140ms, 99th = 210ms

Quality/regression notes:
- Quantized q4f on 13B shows negligible regression on concise instruction-following prompts; we saw ~2-3% drop on certain long-context QA prompts. We recommend running your evaluation set and highlighting any regressions.
- We can run a targeted quality regression eval if you share a representative prompt/sample (or let us run on the attached set).

Next steps:
1) Redwood runs a gated benchmark on your prompt set and shares a short report (we can start this week).
2) If results look good, we propose a 2-week eval on Redwood Dedicated (reserved single-GPU) to validate production traffic.
3) We'll provide a canary rollback plan and quantization recommendation document.

Looping Marissa on the eval coordination. Marissa — can you pick a slot for the benchmark run?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-04-05T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Model fit discovery follow-up — benchmark kickoff + next steps

Hi Sana / Tom — looping Jordan (Perf Eng) and Marissa for pricing/ops details. Quick update and actions we kicked off this morning: 

1) Benchmark kickoff: Jordan started the gated run on your prompt set against Redwood-13B-q4f and Redwood-7B-int8. Initial quick-pass numbers (internal; full report will be posted):
   - Redwood-13B-q4f (1x A100): median latency 85ms (server-side), p95 = 220ms, p99 = 375ms, sustained TPS = 13 r/s
   - Redwood-7B-int8 (1x A100): median latency 38ms, p95 = 140ms, p99 = 210ms, sustained TPS = 32 r/s

2) Cost & token estimate: Marissa is preparing an estimated token-cost table for your workload shape (we'll post as part of the report). Preliminary estimate: 13B-q4f ~ $0.006 / 1k tokens served (hosted price proxy) — final depends on batch and KV cache hit rates.

3) Quality regression summary: early diff on long-context QA: q4f shows small regressions (~2.5% on our automated eval metric for answer accuracy). We recommend running a focused human review for any negative impact on critical flows. If you want, we can mark any flagged prompts and iterate on prompt engineering to mitigate.

4) Dedicated eval pricing: Marissa will follow up with a 2-week Dedicated eval quote (including burst options).

Next actions assigned: 
- Jordan Blake (jordan.blake@redwood.com): complete full benchmark and publish the PDF report to the dashboard link.
- Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com): cost table + Dedicated 2-week eval quote.
- Alex Martinez: schedule a 30-min sync to review results + rollout plan after the report is in.

We'll upload the full PDF and the per-prompt regression csv to the dashboard: https://console.redwood.inference/benchmarks/ordinex-2026 (report will appear under "Ordinex - April 2026 / Prompt set v1").

If that all sounds good, I'll schedule the review for next Tue morning PT.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
